settings.serverAddress: Server address, set when building the extension (variable
settings.extensionPrompt:
Install the Leon browser extension from this repository:
1. Build it with WXT_PUBLIC_LEON_URL={serverUrl} pnpm ext:build.
2. In Chrome, open chrome://extensions, turn on developer mode, choose “Load unpacked extension”, then select extension/.output/chrome-mv3.
3. Open the extension options and let me paste my Leon token myself.
settings.membersDescription: Everyone can see what Leon reads in team tools. Assistant conversations, email, Google Drive, and Slack messages stay with their owner.
